name: Park Mapa
genre: Ambient Persistent Experience / Interactive Map / Meta-collection
description: MKDSLend Park je živi piksel-art svet — istraži 3 zone (Pult, Bina, Šuma), skupljaj Parktokene dnevnim ritualima i gledaj park kako raste kroz sezone.
failed_reason: Superseded by games/2026-06-13-park-mapa/ (isti koncept, potpuno implementiran i released 2026-07-05). KORAK 0d: zatvoreno 2026-07-07.

modules.src/main.js: Bootstrap: inicijalizuje sve module, wires event loop, učitava state
modules.src/config.js: Sve tuning konstante: PT vrednosti, cooldown trajanja, level cene, seeding formule
modules.src/state.js: GameState shape, save/load localStorage, migration između verzija
modules.src/input.js: Mouse, touch, keyboard handlers; pointer abstraction za multi-device
modules.src/render.js: Koordinira DOM/Canvas rendering pipeline; orchestrator za zone render-e
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio API wrapper: ambient loop, SFX, zona aktivacione note, arpeggio
modules.src/systems/park-board.js: Mapa logika: zona stanja, LOD switching, cursor management, parallax
modules.src/systems/easter-eggs.js: Seed-based egg generacija, klik detekcija, dnevni counter, anti-abuse
modules.src/systems/economy.js: PT zarađivanje, trošenje, Budget tracker, weekly reset
modules.src/systems/progression.js: Level-up logika, cost formula (×3 eksponencijalna), vizuelni triggers
modules.src/systems/daily-light.js: Dnevna zona rotacija (seed), completion tracking, fanfare trigger
modules.src/systems/logbook.js: Unosi storage, kategorije, prikaz, export/import JSON
modules.src/systems/prestige.js: Sezonski ciklus, Renovacija logika, žig tracker, skin switching
modules.src/systems/park-legend.js: Kumulativni PT rang (5 stepeni), rang promena animacija
modules.src/systems/npc-board.js: NPC misije, nedeljni reset, progress tracking, reward dispatching
modules.src/systems/savegame.js: localStorage serijalizacija, export JSON, import JSON, version migration
modules.src/zones/pult.js: Pult zone: neon animacije, NPC dijalog pool, mini-priče, easter egg flavor
modules.src/zones/bina.js: Bina zone: animacije, Setlist Tabla renderer, data/bina-setlist.json fetch
modules.src/zones/suma.js: Šuma zone: bioluminiscencija canvas, lišće particle, NPC Mara dijalozi
modules.src/content/bina-setlist-loader.js: Fetch data/bina-setlist.json, parse, exclusive reward check, caching
modules.src/content/brand-hooks.js: MKDSLend/Kluboslavija/Guncati brand integracije; lore fragment pool-ovi
modules.src/ui/splash.js: Šta je novo danas daily banner, first-run onboarding overlay
modules.src/ui/closure.js: Dnevni closure fanfare, zeleni checkmark, session-done poruka
modules.src/ui/logbook-panel.js: Logbook grid view, category tabs, locked entry styling
modules.src/ui/npc-panel.js: NPC kartica layout, misija progress bars, submit reward interaction
modules.src/ui/season-skin.js: CSS varijable switching za sezonske palete, hue-rotate transition
modules.src/ui/cursor-manager.js: Zona-specifični cursor swap, hover state coordination
modules.data/bina-setlist.json: Turnejski datumi Kluboslavija 2026 — editabilni JSON config (non-developer friendly)
modules.styles/base.css: Layout, responsive canvas centering, mobile-first grid
modules.styles/ui.css: HUD elementi, panel-i, dugmad, tooltip styling
modules.styles/game.css: Zona tile animacije, lampion pulse, parallax keyframes, egg glow
modules.styles/theme.css: MKDSLend/Kluboslavija paleta, sezonske CSS varijable, brand font
